_comment: Quarterbacks to exclude from the projections store. v1 models only
receptions / receiving-yards / rushing-yards / TDs from skill-player prop
markets; it does NOT fetch or simulate passing yards/TDs, so a QB's score
here is only their rushing+TD floor and is structurally wrong. The Odds API
returns no position field and QBs are indistinguishable from run-only RBs
by their markets alone (both are 'rushing + anytime-TD, no receiving'), so a
clean odds-derived filter isn't possible; this is a maintained denylist.
Matching is case- and punctuation-insensitive (see sim/slate.py::_normalize_name).
A future version will model QBs with their own methodology (passing markets +
pass-stat correlations) instead of excluding them -- see the roadmap.
Add/remove names as depth charts change; unknown names are simply ignored.
